headline: Visa trims 7% of workforce as fintech belt-tightening spreads
summary: Investing.com -- Visa Inc. (NYSE: V) shares gained 2% on Tuesday following reports that the payments behemoth plans to trim approximately 7% of its workforce. The restructuring will eliminate roughly 2,600 roles—primarily concentrated in tech and product divisions—according to an internal memo from CEO Ryan McInerney obtained by Bloomberg.
